newsItems.title: Crush and Winkler own the CSL's first season
newsItems.body: Charlotte Crush, a freshman at Tennessee, led all swimmers with 209.5 points across the inaugural College Swimming League season, picking up nine jackpots along the way. On the men's side, Kaii Winkler paced the field. It's a remarkable debut for a competition format still finding its footing.

newsItems.title: Kornev breaks the 50-second barrier in the 100 fly
newsItems.body: Russia's Egor Kornev clocked a 49.51 in the 100m butterfly at the Russian Short Course Championships, a lifetime best and his first time under 50 seconds. That kind of breakthrough mid-season is the sort of thing that gets people talking about Worlds.

newsItems.title: Jupiter boys win their first-ever Florida 4A title
newsItems.body: The Jupiter boys claimed their first state championship at the Florida 4A State Meet, edging runner-up Cypress Bay by just 5.5 points after winning the 400 free relay. The Riverview Sarasota girls defended their title on the other side of the psych sheet.

newsItems.title: Ekk shatters the Florida 3A 200 IM record
newsItems.body: Owen Ekk went 1:43.62 in the 200 IM at the Florida 3A State Meet, demolishing the previous record of 1:45.02 that had stood since 2022. Ponte Vedra took the girls team title and St. Petersburg won the boys crown.

athlete.name: Torri Huske
athlete.photoCredit: Photo: The White House, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
athlete.bio:
Torri Huske is an American competitive swimmer born on December 7, 2002, from Arlington, Virginia. She has a Chinese given name, 簡愛, reflecting her heritage through her mother, who immigrated from China. Huske began swimming at age six with the Arlington Aquatic Club and attended Yorktown High School, where she became a decorated competitor before going on to represent the United States internationally.

Huske is the reigning Olympic champion in the 100-meter butterfly and holds world records in the 4x100-meter medley and 4x100-meter mixed medley relays. At the 2024 Summer Olympics she won three gold and two silver medals. At the 2022 World Championships she won three gold and three bronze medals, and at the 2020 Olympics she earned a silver medal in the 4x100-meter medley relay.
